author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryse Wilson designated for assignment
desc: The Cubs designated Bryse Wilson for assignment.
impact: Wilson will head to waivers to make room for the signing of Jake Woodford.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: William Bergolia (shin) begins running progession
desc: White Sox infield prospect William Bergolia (shin) has begun a running progression and is hitting and throwing normally.
impact: Bergolia is on the 7-day minor league injured list with a shin contusion, but appears on track in his recovery. The 21-year-old middle infielder lacks power, but hit .457 with two stolen bases in 10 games before hitting the shelf.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Prelander Berroa (elbow) to throw again in 1-2 weeks
desc: White Sox right-hander Prelander Berroa (elbow) will begin throwing again in the next one to two weeks.
impact: Berroa had a setback in his recovery from Tommy John surgery when he exited an ACL rehab start on May 13 after just four pitches. Originally expected to return in July, it appears an August return seems more realistic at this point.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Drew Thorpe (elbow/appendectomy) throws live BP Friday
desc: White Sox right-hander Drew Thorpe threw a live bullpen session on Friday.
impact: Thorpe's recovery from Tommy John surgery hit a speed bump when he underwent an appendectomy in May, but he has resumed throwing to the point of getting into a live bullpen session on Friday. The 25-year-old missed the entire 2025 season after posting a 5.48 ERA in nine starts in his MLB debut in the 2024 campaign.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Ky Bush (elbow) throws long toss
desc: White Sox left-hander Ky Bush (elbow) has progressed to throwing long toss.
impact: Bush had a setback in his recovery from Tommy John surgery in late May, but is seemingly getting back on track. The southpaw missed the entire 2025 season due to his elbow surgery and isn't expected to return until after the All-Star break after his setback.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jordan Romano selected by Rockies
desc: The Rockies have selected the contract of right-hander Jordan Romano from Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Romano signed with the Rockies on a minors deal in May, but has yet to appear with the big club. He struggled to a 10.13 ERA in eight outings early this season and posted a 3.72 ERA in 10 outings for the Isotopes prior to his promotion.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Seth Halvorsen (shoulder) placed on 15-day IL
desc: The Rockies have placed right-hander Seth Halvorsen on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation.
impact: Halvorsen and Tomoyuki Sugano were both placed on the injured list on Saturday with the club recalling left-hander Sean Sullivan and right-hander Jordan Romano. Halvorsen has posted a 4.74 ERA across 21 relief outings for the Rockies this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Sean Sullivan officially recalled to start Saturday versus Giants
desc: The Rockies have officially recalled left-hander Sean Sullivan to start Saturday's home game against the Giants.
impact: Sullivan was named as Saturday's starting pitcher once right-hander Tomoyuki Sugano was scratched with back spasms, and later placed on the injured list. The southpaw has struggled to an 8.64 ERA in four starts for the Rockies while posting a 5.60 ERA across 11 starts with Triple-A Albuquerque.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Tomoyuki Sugano (back) placed on IL
desc: The Rockies have placed right-hander Tomoyuki Sugano on the 15-day injured list with back spasms.
impact: Sugano was scheduled to start Saturday's game against the Giants, but will instead hit the IL while Sean Sullivan was recalled to start Saturday's contest. Sugano has posted a 4.80 ERA through 16 starts this season, although his tiny 5.12 K/9 keeps himself off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JR Ritchie to pitch out of bullpen for Braves
desc: JR Ritchie told reporters he'll be pitching out of the bullpen.
impact: Ritchie was recalled on Saturday. He'll add some length in the bullpen for Atlanta.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Spencer Bivens called up by Giants
desc: The Giants are calling up Spencer Bivens.
impact: Bivens will be up in the majors for the first time this season. Matt Gage went on the IL as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Gage (knee) to undergo MRI Monday
desc: Matt Gage is scheduled to undergo an MRI on Monday.
impact: Gage has been dealing with left elbow discomfort for roughly two weeks. There should be an update on his status later on next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Salvador Perez (elbow) not in lineup Saturday
desc: Salvador Perez is not in the Royals lineup on Saturday against the Phillies.
impact: Perez is continuing to deal with soreness in his right elbow. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zebby Matthews leaves early with foot injury Saturday
desc: The Twins say Zebby Matthews left Saturday's game with a right foot laceration.
impact: Matthews will head to be further evaluated. There should be another update on his status following the game.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rhett Lowder to move to bullpen through All-Star break
desc: Reds manager Terry Francona said Rhett Lowder will be moved to the bullpen through the All-Star break.
impact: Lowder posted a 5.18 ERA over five starts in June. He'll add some length in the bullpen over the next week for Cincinnati.
